title: Local bounded flat complex construction
statement: construction of U,C,d and bounded flat quasi-coherent terms

proof.text: Use Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset at the top open to choose an affine open neighbourhood U of t. The formal conclusion imposes no comparison with cohomology, so choose the actual zero cochain complex C=HomologicalComplex.zero and d=0.

Evaluation of the zero complex is a zero object in every degree, by Functor.map_isZero and HomologicalComplex.isZero_zero. Thus the defining IsStrictlyGE and IsStrictlyLE conditions hold with bound zero.

For each pair of affine opens in the definition of IsFlatOver, evaluation of a zero sheaf has zero module of sections. ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton makes its underlying type subsingleton. Typeclass inference then gives a free module and hence Module.Flat for the specified restricted scalar action.

The free sheaf on PEmpty is zero: use injectivity of freeHomEquiv on the identity and zero maps, since functions on PEmpty are equal. It is quasi-coherent by the proved SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent_free. Therefore the quasi-coherent object property ContainsZero, and prop_of_isZero gives quasi-coherence of all terms of C.

proof_origin.description: Direct proof of the unchanged termwise existence statement from affine neighbourhoods and the zero complex. This does not construct a cohomology model; the missing comparison hypothesis in the subsequent base-change statement is reported.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_proper_flat_cohomology_model_data_construction {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T)
    (F : X.Modules) [IsSeparated f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [HasInjectiveResolutions X.Modules] [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hF : F.IsFlatOver f) (t : T) :
    ∃ (U : T.Opens) (C : CochainComplex U.toScheme.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ),
      t ∈ U ∧ IsAffine U.toScheme ∧ C.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧ C.IsStrictlyLE d ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 U.toScheme)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
